title: Backport Runner — Pocket Notes & Cutover Checklist
content:
Backport Runner Pocket Notes (short-lived personal scratchpad)

Purpose:
- Lightweight checklist for the weekend backport/cutover. Meant for quick ops use; not the canonical runbook.
- Focus: land hotfixes for REL-2143 and REL-2201, validate on dedicated, then promote.

Run owner: Maya Patel (me)
Primary on-call: Elliot Ramos (eng-sre)
Secondary: Priya Nair (releng)
Escalation: Olivia Chen (eng-lead) if SQL changes have unexpected latency
Pager: +1-415-555-0198 (pager for SRE team)
Slack channel: #releng-cutovers (watch for "cutover: start/complete")

Cutover window (target): 2025-02-18 02:00–04:00 UTC
Timeline (local mental model):
- 01:30 UTC: final smoke in canary cluster (dry run)
- 01:45 UTC: ops sync — confirm approvals, backups complete
- 02:00 UTC: begin backports to release branch, open small PRs (no big refactors)
- 02:20 UTC: apply migrations on staging-dedicated (non-prod replica)
- 02:40 UTC: promote canary traffic 10%
- 03:20 UTC: full promote if green
- 03:40 UTC: post-cutover monitoring, perf checks
- 04:00 UTC: sign-off and close channel

Pre-cutover quick checklist (must be green before 02:00):
- [ ] Nightly backup completed and verified (DB snapshot id: snap-20250218-rel)
- [ ] SRE ack on capacity for burst (ticket: SRE-921)
- [ ] All PRs for backports are opened and linked to JIRA tickets
- [ ] Feature flags required are in place: toggle_hotfix_rel2143 = off by default
- [ ] Canary cluster has current-prod image pulled and smoke tests pass

Backport list (ordered by risk):
- REL-2143 — token-cache eviction bug (high priority) — PR: serving-runtime/pull/786 — owner: Maya — apply to release/1.12, then cherry-pick to hotfix/1.12.1 — verification: token reuse metric, 5m p95 latency
- REL-2201 — model-routing edge-case (medium) — PR: platform-config/pull/432 — owner: Priya — staged config change; no DB migration
- REL-2198 — logging typo (low) — owner: Elliot — trivial, will land last

Quick commands (cheat sheet):
- Checkout release branch: $ git fetch origin && git checkout release/1.12 && git pull
- Cherry-pick PR branch: $ git cherry-pick -x <commit>
- Push hotfix branch: $ git push origin HEAD:hotfix/1.12.1
- Create PR from hotfix to release: use GH web UI (fast path) and request SRE review
- Apply migration in non-prod: $ kubectl -n dedicated exec deploy/mig-runner -- ./run-migrations --target release/1.12 --dry-run=false
- Healthcheck curl: $ curl -sS -H "x-api-key: <key>" https://canary.api.redwood.ai/_health | jq .

Verification checklist (canary > prod):
- [ ] Smoke endpoints: /v1/health, /v1/generate, /v1/kv-status respond 200 within 200ms
- [ ] Token reuse error rate drops to <= 0.1% over 10m (use observability dashboard)
- [ ] No increase in OOM or GPU errors on serving nodes
- [ ] Latency p95 for small prompts stays within 1.1x pre-cutover baseline

Rollback criteria (abort and revert immediately):
- Token reuse error rate spikes > 1% sustained for 10m after deployment
- Any persistent 5xx > 0.5% traffic for 5m
- Node-level OOM events or model crashes on >1 node

Rollback steps (fast path):
- Post message: "cutover: rolling back — reverting hotfix/1.12.1" in #releng-cutovers
- Revert merge on release branch (git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>) and push
- Trigger platform-config rollback: set model-routing config to previous sha via Terraform rollback plan
- Re-deploy previous image: set deployment image tag to previous-stable and scale-up

Comms templates (use minimal edits):
- Start: "Cutover start — applying backports REL-2143/2201. Watch #releng-cutovers. ETA 60–90m. Paging SRE if anything critical. — Maya"
- Canary green: "Canary at 10% — looks good (token metrics ok). Promoting to 50%."
- Full promote: "Full promote complete. Watching metrics for 30m. Slack thread pinned."
- Rollback: "Rolling back hotfix/1.12.1 due to increased 5xx. Reverting now. Notifying affected teams."

Post-cutover tasks (do before closing channel):
- [ ] Merge hotfix into mainline (if verified)
- [ ] Add changes to release notes (REL-2143 entry)
- [ ] Kick off CI job to run extended regression suite (job id: CI-5472)
- [ ] Archive logs and attach to JIRA tickets
- [ ] Quick retro note: what surprised us, what slowed the run, suggestions for next time

Notes to self / running thoughts (scratchpad):
- Keep PRs tiny — drop any unrelated changes. No refactors in backports.
- If migration touches DB indexes, coordinate with data infra lead (Tom). Avoid long locks during business hours.
- Remember to re-enable toggle_hotfix_rel2143 after verification window off (ops manual step)
- Checkpoint: if canary shows <1% error and stable for 30m, send heads-up to product and close fast

Open questions (to resolve before next time):
- Are we comfortable with 02:00 UTC window for EMEA traffic? Might want earlier if APAC load expected. Check analytics.
- Do we have a fast-path single-commit revert script? (would save ~6m)

Last-minute reminders:
- Have coffee. Keep Slack audible. Keep phone charged.
- If stuck, ask Elliot to take over so I can coordinate with product/customer success.

-- end of personal pocket notes --
(merge into canonical runbook after post-cutover retro)
